title: Advanced Tissue Engineering
description:
Prerequisite: Must have completed at least one biology course; and MATH241. Or permission of ENGR-Fischell Department of Bioengineering department.
Recommended: BSCI330 and BIOE340.
Restriction: Permission of ENGR-Fischell Department of Bioengineering department. A review of the fundamental principles involved in the design of engineered tissues and organs. Both biological and engineering fundamentals will be considered.
